name: April Fools'
source:
Girl says: “Mom will live until tomorrow.” But today is April Fools today. Does she lie?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女孩说：“妈妈会活到明天。”但今天是愚人节。她撒谎了吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
